subject: french
title: Customs and Traditions
welcome_lead: Experiences include customs that shape communal life. Festivals and traditions in francophone countries open culture and language.
meta_desc: French: customs, traditions, festivals across the francophone world.
final_note: Tradition lives in language — to name a custom is to honour it.

walkthroughs.body_html: Use La Fete de la Musique a lieu le 21 juin. Add atmosphere with il regne une ambiance festive.
Le patrimoine immateriel includes language, music, oral tradition. UNESCO recognises French gastronomie since 2010.
Use tandis que (whereas): En France on celebre le 14 juillet, tandis qu'au Quebec c'est la Saint-Jean.
